_comment: OURS, for the simulator and the tests only (v0.1.61): the students' real color_cannon_config.json is not in the tree yet. Sections and keys are the ones their color_cannon_receiver.py reads; the values are placeholders chosen so the sim's dock geometry passes their checks. allowed_colors red = the handbook's target window (3.3.4). The pump is disabled and never used here (the sim runs the receiver without --live). fake_cannon_pi.py copies this file next to a copy of the receiver in the run folder and sets key_file / port there.
